summary: Query a device object stored at this+0x80 through its vtable method at +0x14 with a command block, then compute collision-response mapping values: range endpoints, inverse-range scaling, and an interpolated position written to the a3..a8 outputs. All computation is skipped when the device pointer is null or the query fails.

operations.description: If the device pointer stored at this+0x80 is null, skip all response computation and return.
Build a request block on the stack: v15[0]=24, v15[1]=16, v15[2]=a2, v15[3]=1.
Invoke the device vtable method at +0x14 (5th method) with (v10, 4, v15); continue only when it returns zero.
Read the two range endpoints from the returned block: v11 from v15[4] and v12 from v15[5].
Store the lower endpoint into *a7 and the inverse of (v12 - v11) into *a6, or 0.0 when the endpoints are equal.
Compute the interpolated position *a3 = a10 * (v12 - v11) + v11.
Compute inverse-range factors *a4 and *a5 from the mid-span positions (v13 + v11 and v12 - *a8), defaulting each to 0.0 when the denominator would be zero.
